name: Let's Clean Up with Midori and Shin!
source:
Shin Tsukimi is going through a hard time and anyone can see that in his room!! Good thing, Hiyori-kun is there to help him... Right?

Win some minigames and help Shin clean his messy room!

[From [url=https://w0nderlands.itch.io/lets-clean-up-with-midori-and-shin]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
新月见正在经历一段艰难的时期，任何人都可以在他的房间里看到这一点！还好，日和君来帮助他……对吧？

赢得一些迷你游戏并帮助Shin清理他凌乱的房间！

[来自[url=https://w0nderlands.itch.io/lets-clean-up-with-midori-and-shin]Itch.io[/url]]
